status_summary: Executive Order 14162 (signed 2025-01-20, published 2025-01-30) directed ending or revoking financial commitments made under the UN climate framework and revoked the U.S. International Climate Finance Plan. A letter dated 2025-03-04 announced that the US board member and alternate on the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage were stepping down and would not be replaced by a US representative. A presidential memorandum signed 2026-01-07 directed withdrawal from the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, among other bodies, including ending funding. The sources reviewed do not show efforts to persuade other countries to reconsider their contributions.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14162 published; section 3 directs revoking UN climate framework financial commitments and revokes the International Climate Finance Plan.
US board member and alternate withdrew from the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage board by letter, with seats not to be replaced by a US representative.

Presidential memorandum directed withdrawal from listed international bodies, including the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, defined for UN entities as ending participation and funding; published 2026-01-16.
